cases.prefer_schedule_title: PACKAGED ROOFTOP AIR CONDITIONING UNIT SCHEDULE (GAS HEAT)
cases.review_note: The accepted body is the heavy-line packaged rooftop-unit cabinet containing the circular fan mark. The larger prohibited rectangle is a surrounding clearance/connection envelope that includes the printed RTU-1 tag and therefore cannot be presented as the physical unit body.

cases.prefer_schedule_title: PACKAGED ROOFTOP AIR CONDITIONING UNIT SCHEDULE (GAS HEAT)
cases.review_note: The accepted body is the heavy-line RTU-2 cabinet and not the much larger dashed/connection envelope. The exact printed tag is separate and must not be swallowed into the blue physical-body box.
CU-2 is the separate heavy rectangular condensing-unit body immediately below the boxed printed tag. The tag outline itself is a prohibited text container, not installed equipment.
CU-1 is the compact heavy rectangle to the right of its boxed tag. The text container is visually and geometrically distinct and must never self-verify.
The plan body is the circular fan glyph beneath EF-1. Baker sheet M0.02 independently declares the project FAN glyph in SYMBOLS LEGEND - PIPING DIAGRAMS; the boxed EF-1 text is not the fan.

review.method: full-page and source-coordinate Session.viewSheet visual review plus exact PDF text and vector coordinates
review.note: This project adds sparse rooftop equipment, compact condensing units, and a real project-legend fan transfer. It explicitly pins physical bodies separately from tag boxes and clearance/connection envelopes.
